newsitem.title: USA: New Horizon Kids to open facility.
newsitem.headline: New Horizon Kids to open facility.

text.p: New Horizon Kids Quest Inc said Monday it signed a contract with the Soaring Eagle Casino in Mt. Pleasant, Michigan, to provide a 3,800 square foot supervised video entertainment facility.
The site is the company's third announced video entertainment facility and is anticipated to open in late June. The company already operates a Kids Quest child care facility within the casino.

"The addition of a video entertainment center with non-violent games to the Soaring Eagle Casino will add to the current amenity mix at Soaring Eagle that currently includes a Kids Quest child care facility," Kids Quest President Sue Dunkley said in a statement.
